human.name: Human
human.description: Adaptable and ambitious. No racial bonuses or penalties — humans simply make the most of what they have.
human.passive: Versatile: gain +5% bonus XP from all sources.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: Ancient and graceful. Elves are swift of foot and sharp of mind, but lack brute strength and physical endurance.
elf.passive: Keen Sight: immune to blind effects.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Stout and stubborn. Dwarves are among the hardiest people in the realm, though they move with less grace than most.
dwarf.passive: Stone Skin: reduce all physical damage by 5%.

orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Fierce and powerful. Orcs dominate in raw strength and resilience, but their temper costs them wit and fortune.
orc.passive: Bloodlust: gain +10% damage when HP is below 30%.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.description: Small, cheerful, and absurdly lucky. Halflings are not built for hard combat, but fortune seems to follow them everywhere.
halfling.passive: Lucky Break: 10% chance to fully dodge a fatal blow and survive with 1 HP.
